title: [Master]- [Planning Worksheet] Production Copy to Req. Wksh fails because destination fields are missing
summary: Copying production planning lines to a requisition worksheet through the Carry Out Action Msg. - Plan. report no longer fails because of missing destination fields. The report now fills in the needed fields, and a new test covers the scenario.
key_points: Production Copy to Req. Wksh. in the planning worksheet previously failed due to missing destination fields
Report Carry Out Action Msg. - Plan. now populates the missing fields
New test added in SCM Plan Req. Wksht.
